## About
Intercoastal Air is a fully insured licensed contractor based in Pompano Beach. We handle residential and commercial installation, repair and maintenance of HVAC equipment, and commercially we work on apartment buildings, office buildings and warehouses.
Our goal is simple: get your project or service done right the first time. Neighbors tend to know us by name. Eli picks up the phone and comes out to look, and Carrie at the office helps keep things moving.
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 60 reviews, and we'd be glad to help with your heating and air conditioning too.

## Services
- Residential and commercial installation, repair and maintenance: Installing, repairing and maintaining HVAC equipment for homes and businesses.
- Apartment buildings, office buildings and warehouses: Our commercial work covers apartment buildings, office buildings and warehouses.
- Service Maintenance Contract: Ongoing maintenance to keep your system running.
- Water Source Systems: Installation and service for water source systems.
- A/C coil cleaning: One gym owner said the team sent pictures of their dirty coils, cleaned them, and stopped the leak.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We work across Broward County, Dade County and the Palm Beach area, including Pompano Beach. Check our service area list or give us a call to confirm your neighborhood.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. Our commercial work includes apartment buildings, office buildings and warehouses.
